    AI Overview
    Game 1 of the 2026 NBA Playoffs between the Los Angeles Lakers and Houston Rockets is on Saturday, April 18, at 8:30 p.m. ET (5:30 p.m. PT) at Crypto.com Arena, broadcast on ABC and available to stream via the ESPN app. Streaming options include FuboTV, DirecTV Stream, Sling TV, and ESPN+. 
    Watch Options for Lakers vs. Rockets (Game 1, April 18): 
    • TV Channel: ABC (nationwide).
    • Streaming Services: FuboTV, DirecTV Stream, Sling TV, and ESPN+.
    • Digital Apps: ESPN app.
    • In-Person: Tickets are available on StubHub. 
    Series Schedule & Channels 
    • Game 1: Saturday, April 18, 8:30 p.m. ET on ABC.
    • Game 2: Tuesday, April 21 on NBC/Peacock/DIRECTV.
    • Game 3: Friday, April 24 on Prime Video.
    • Game 4: Sunday, April 26 on NBC/Peacock/DIRECTV. 
    For in-market viewers, FuboTV offers a free trial to catch the game. Out-of-market viewers can use NBA League Pass.
